name: Biblioplex
description: The Biblioplex is Strixhaven's great library, a location where Liliana once researched the Raven Man.

description_citations.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

summary.text: The Biblioplex is Strixhaven's great library, a location where Liliana once researched the Raven Man.

citations.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

bio.text: In 2022, Liliana researched the Raven Man in the Biblioplex, where he appeared again and urged her to search deeper.

citations.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

bio.text: The Phyrexian Invasion later damaged Strixhaven and killed many faculty.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

status.text: The latest event shows Strixhaven damaged by the Phyrexian Invasion, with many faculty killed.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana, teaching as Professor Onyx, walks the Biblioplex unrecognized by the other professors.
timeline.quote: the other professors of Strixhaven hadn't recognized Liliana Vess when she introduced herself by an entirely different name

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana catches a masked intruder stealing books, who strikes her arm with a sickening spell.
timeline.quote: The words fell away as a streak of purplish light flew from the figure's hand.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana identifies the intruder as one of the Oriq, who warns her that her days are numbered.
timeline.quote: Then you know that your days are numbered.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Talonrook interrupts, and the intruder vanishes.
timeline.quote: When she turned back, the intruder was gone.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Tavver, an Oriq agent, hides in a tunnel beneath the Biblioplex after failing his mission.
timeline.quote: Tavver didn't know how long he had waited in that cramped tunnel beneath the Biblioplex

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Tavver recalls the professor with violet eyes who meant to kill him in a fight over a book Extus wanted.
timeline.quote: Tavver had seen true darkness in that professor's violet eyes.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint spills tea on ancient books and fixes it with a like-to-like spell.
timeline.quote: The spilled tea began to rise, small droplets floating from the page to fall back into Quint's cup.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan siphons power from a water elemental in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: Electricity crackled and leapt across her fingers as she pulled the veins of power out of its watery surface, toward her.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan tells Will she has learned that breaking the rules gets things done and leaves him.
timeline.quote: I learned that when you're not afraid to break the rules, you can get a whole lot done.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina recalls finding the tome in the Biblioplex, the meditations of a mage fascinated by life and death (flashback).
timeline.quote: Part manual, part journal, it captured the meditations of an unnamed mage fascinated by life, death, and the realms locked between them.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx tells them the mage hunters have formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: They've formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus receives a book found in the East Wing from Tavver.
timeline.quote: I found it in the East Wing, just as you said, sir.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus swings Tavver into a Silverquill student's dark spell and then kills the student.
timeline.quote: Extus tightened his grip on Tavver's arm and pulled him close, spinning him into the spell's path.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone takes out the Vorzani Conjecture book from the Biblioplex, last signed out by Nimiroti.
timeline.quote: Zimone had peeped into the record scroll as Isabough's branches reached to the farthest shelves to find the book.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone finds a note in her grandmother's handwriting hidden in the book.
timeline.quote: Packages of Ribbons. Numbers one step backward to go on forever. Living books that talk to you on the pathway of light.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: During the Oriq attack Extus Narr infiltrates the Biblioplex and summons the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.
timeline.quote: During the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven , Extus Narr infiltrated the Biblioplex and summoned the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.

citation.text: "Biblioplex", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invocation of the Founders is used during the Invasion, creating a fractal tree that breaks through the building's ceiling.
timeline.quote: the spell was housed deep within the library, until it was used during the New Phyrexian Invasion , when a massive fractal tree was created in the chamber's center, breaking through the building's ceiling.

citation.text: "Biblioplex", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint gives Killian a book about the Mute Quillancer who used sign language.
timeline.quote: Dobarius Egolt, the Mute Quillancer

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Hallucination or not, Liliana researches the Raven Man in the Biblioplex, where he appears again and urges her to search deeper.
timeline.quote: "You aren't going far enough back," he said.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds a name in A History of Terisiare, concludes the Raven Man is real, and resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake.
timeline.quote: She could cleanse this tiny bit of evil from the Multiverse, for Gideon's sake.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A dwarf student calls for help and is dragged away by a compleated figure, and Quint's cry draws Dean Shaile's attention.
timeline.quote: Dean Shaile's head abruptly swiveled around.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dean Shaile seizes Killian, demanding the whereabouts of his father.
timeline.quote: Where is your father?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dean Embrose Lu arrives in a storm of ink that melts compleated professors and rescues Killian.
timeline.quote: Dean Embrose Lu landed beside them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Embrose flings the students out of the fight so they can find the invocation, and Killian sends him supportive words.
timeline.quote: And without warning lashes of black whipped around the students' torsos

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The ritual's overload turns the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree that smashes through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: and kept growing , boughs forming a perfect helix of steps

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
timeline.quote: but alive, and himself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina reports that Quint vanished in a burst of light, and Liliana wonders if he sparked.
timeline.quote: If Quint's spark ignited, he could still be alive

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends the students to find the Invocation; Embrose fights compleated faculty.
timeline.quote: Embrose arrived to fight off the full group of compleated faculty

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion, Quint tries to cover for Rootha at the Invocation of the Founders with raw magic, his spark ignites, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "New Phyrexian Invasion of Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, Quint covers her part with raw magic, his spark ignites and he planeswalks away; Rootha is wounded.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion damages Strixhaven and kills many faculty.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion, much of the university campus was damaged or destroyed, and a significant number of faculty lost their lives.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Flashback to the Biblioplex invocation, where the Phyrexian Nassari taunts Rootha and she loses concentration.
timeline.quote: "You're a burden. You cling.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Quint shores up the casting, saving the others, and later becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: The only reason any of us survive is because of Quint, a quiet boy from Lorehold.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

relations.quote: an awe-inspiring and hallowed chamber at the very center of the Biblioplex, the Central Campus , and Strixhaven itself

citation.text: "Biblioplex", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
